Computer components refer to the various hardware parts that come together to assemble a PC build. These components work collaboratively, allowing the entire system to function efficiently. Each PC component plays a vital role in shaping the performance, functionality, and user experience of a computer system. The primary components essential for building a desktop PC include the processor (CPU), motherboard, RAM, storage devices (HDD or SSD), graphics card (GPU), power supply (PSU), cooling system, and casing. Best Computer Hub Ltd understands this and offers a vast collection of PC components from leading brands at the most competitive prices in Bangladesh.

Types of PC Components

Desktop computers are built with various components that work in unison. Each component plays its role in the entire PC build. Below are the different types of computer components:

Processor

The computer processor, or CPU, is often referred to as the "brain" of a computer. It serves as the most crucial PC component when building a desktop. Intel and AMD are the two main manufacturers of computer processors. Intel's latest Core i9-14900K, i7-14700K, i5-13600K, and i3-13400 series processors are widely used in desktop and laptop computers, offering a range of performance levels for different computing needs. AMD's latest Ryzen 9 7950X3D, Ryzen 7 7800X3D, and Ryzen 5 7600X CPUs provide excellent value and performance, particularly for mid-range and high-end gaming setups.

Motherboard

The motherboard is the backbone of a PC build, connecting all components together. This PC component provides slots and connectors for the CPU, RAM, storage devices, and expansion cards. Popular brands like Asus, Gigabyte, MSI, and ASRock offer a wide range of Intel and AMD motherboards. Notable series include Asus's ROG Maximus Z790, Gigabyte's AORUS Elite X670E, MSI's MEG Z790 Ace, and ASRock's Taichi X670E.

Graphics Card

The graphics card is a specialized PC component designed to handle graphics rendering and video processing tasks, essential for gaming, video editing, and other graphics-intensive applications. NVIDIA's latest GeForce RTX 4090, RTX 4080, and RTX 4070 Ti are the most powerful GPUs for gaming and content creation. AMD's Radeon RX 7900 XT and RX 7800 XT provide excellent performance and value. Intel has also entered the GPU market with its Arc A770 and Arc A750 models.

RAM

RAM is another critical component when building a new PC or upgrading an existing one. More RAM generally means better multitasking and overall system performance. The latest DDR5 RAM offers initial bus speeds starting at 4800 MHz and up to 8000 MHz. Popular brands and series include Team's Elite and Delta series, Corsair's Vengeance and Dominator series, G.Skill's Trident Z5 and Ripjaws V series, and Kingston's Fury Beast lineup.

Storage Solutions

Storage is crucial for storing your operating system, applications, and files. Here are the two main types of storage to consider: Hard Disk Drives (HDD): HDDs offer larger storage capacities at lower prices but are slower than SSDs. They are suitable for bulk storage of files and media. Solid State Drives (SSD): SSDs are the modern choice for storage. They offer significantly faster data access speeds compared to HDDs, leading to quicker boot times and faster loading of applications and games. SSDs come in various formats, including SATA SSDs and NVMe M.2 SSDs, with the latter providing even higher speeds. An SSD can greatly enhance your PC’s performance, making it a must-have component for any build. The computer case, or chassis, houses all the internal components. It provides physical protection and plays a crucial role in airflow management and thermal performance. Brands like NZXT, Corsair, Fractal Design, and Lian Li offer a wide range of cases. Notable models include Corsair 4000D Airflow, NZXT H510, and Lian Li PC-O11 Dynamic.

Cooling Solution

Effective cooling is vital for maintaining optimal performance. Popular casing cooler brands like Noctua, Corsair, and DeepCool offer various sizes, including 120mm, 140mm, and 200mm fans. For CPU cooling, notable options include Cooler Master Hyper 212 Black Edition and Corsair H100i RGB Platinum for liquid cooling solutions.

Monitor

The monitor is an output display device for desktop PCs, often featuring LED backlighting. Popular brands like HP, Acer, Dell, and LG offer a range of monitors suitable for various applications. The latest models include Dell UltraSharp U2720Q (4K), Acer Predator X34 (ultra-wide gaming), and LG 27GN950 (gaming monitor).

Types of Monitors Available in BD

Monitors can be classified based on features and mechanisms: Gaming Monitor: Features high refresh rates for an optimal gaming experience, with models like Acer Predator X27 and ASUS ROG Swift PG259QN. Curved Monitor: Ideal for immersive experiences, popular models include Samsung Odyssey G9 and LG UltraWide 38GN950. Touch Monitor: Provides interactive capabilities; notable models include Dell P2418HT and ViewSonic TD2230. Ultra-wide Monitor: Offers a broader display area; examples include LG 34GN850 and Samsung CJ791.

Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS)

Offline UPS: A basic type, like the MaxGreen MG-LI-EAP-650VA, suitable for home desktop PCs and small workstations. Line-Interactive UPS: Provides enhanced protection, such as the KSTAR 3000VA, correcting minor power fluctuations. Online UPS: Offers the highest level of power protection; consider MaxGreen MGOE-W1KS 1KVA for budget-friendly options. Mini UPS: Designed for smaller devices like routers; the Marsriva KP1 Ultra 30W is a notable choice.

Speakers and Headphones

Speakers: Brands like JBL, Sony, and Edifier offer a range of options, including Bluetooth connectivity and RGB illumination. Headphones: Brands like HyperX, Logitech, and Sennheiser provide excellent options for gaming, music, and online meetings.

Software and Office Equipment

License Software: Essential for managing hardware and software resources; popular operating systems include Windows 11 and Ubuntu. Office Equipment: Includes printers, scanners, and photocopiers, with leading brands like Canon, Brother, and Epson.

Check Out the Best Quality Wireless Routers in Bangladesh

A router is a networking device that directs data on various computer networks, allowing multiple devices to share the same internet connection. Often confused with modems or network hubs, routers integrate the functions of these devices to manage and direct traffic efficiently. In today's world, routers are essential for commercial, institutional, and private use. Best Computer Hub, a leading tech retail brand, offers a wide range of high-quality Wi-Fi, dual-band, and wired routers at competitive prices in Bangladesh.

Popular Router Brands at Best Computer Hub

At Best Computer Hub, you can find a variety of high-performing wired and wireless routers from popular brands such as Tenda, TP-Link, Totolink, Mikrotik, Wavlink, D-Link, HUAWEI, Mi, Cisco, Netgear, Mercusys, and Netis. These brands offer reliable networking solutions at convenient prices in Bangladesh.

Key Features to Consider in a Router

Wi-Fi Frequency and Transmission Most routers operate on the 2.4 GHz band, but some offer dual-band capabilities, transmitting on both 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz frequencies. Dual-band routers are ideal for managing different types of network traffic. For instance, while a standard router may transmit up to 300 Mbps on 2.4 GHz, gaming routers can reach up to 1000 Mbps. The latest quad-band routers, featuring Wi-Fi 7, double the speed up to 320 MHz or 6 GHz compared to previous generations. Antenna Type Routers come with either omnidirectional or directional antennas. Omnidirectional antennas provide wide coverage with a round radiation pattern, suitable for general indoor and outdoor use. Directional antennas focus the signal in a specific direction, creating a limited coverage area. Brands like D-Link use dipole antennas for optimal coverage. Connectivity Modern routers, including those with Wi-Fi 7, offer wireless connectivity, ensuring a broad range of Wi-Fi coverage. This feature is essential for homes and offices of all sizes. Ethernet Ports Ethernet ports connect devices directly to the internet, with some routers offering Gigabit Ethernet for high-speed connections. Typically, routers have one WAN port and 2-4 LAN ports for improved connectivity. Varieties of Routers Wireless Routers; Wireless routers manage and distribute internet traffic without physical cables. They convert data packets from wired broadband into radio signals, providing Wi-Fi connectivity for various devices. Wired Routers; Wired routers connect devices in a local area network (LAN) through wired connections, acting as a central hub with built-in firewall capabilities. They come with different Ethernet speeds, such as Gigabit (1000 Mbps) and Fast Ethernet (100 Mbps). Outdoor Routers; Outdoor routers are designed for long-distance Wi-Fi networks, with ranges from 1 km to 10 km, ideal for covering large or remote areas. Gigabit Routers; Gigabit routers offer 10x faster speeds than standard Ethernet, transmitting data at rates up to 1000 Mbps and covering up to 2000 sq ft. Pocket Routers; Pocket routers are battery-powered with 4G/5G SIM slots, providing portable Wi-Fi connectivity. They support speeds between 150 Mbps to 300 Mbps and can connect up to 10 devices simultaneously. Mesh Routers; Mesh routers create a seamless network by linking multiple Wi-Fi nodes, covering areas up to 5500 sq ft, and providing flexible network paths. Tri-band and Dual-band Routers; Tri-band routers connect to three wireless bands, while dual-band routers use two frequency channels, optimizing network speed and bandwidth. Using Routers for Different Purposes Regular Users; For personal use, routers with speeds of 300 Mbps, 2-4 external antennas, and 2.4 GHz frequency are sufficient. Brands like Tenda, TP-Link, and D-Link offer excellent options. Gamers; Gaming routers provide speeds above 1000 Mbps, multiple antennas, robust security, and dual-core processors for a fast, stable gaming experience. High-end gaming routers from brands like ASUS and TP-Link are available at Best Computer Hub. Offices; Business-class routers from Cisco, Juniper, and Ubiquiti are ideal for office use, offering advanced features and support. Travelers; Portable routers with SIM slots and power banks are perfect for travelers, providing remote Wi-Fi connectivity. Things to Consider Before Buying a Router Wi-Fi Coverage: Ensure the router covers the required area. Brands like TP-Link and Netgear offer models with varying coverage. Speed: Choose a router that meets your speed requirements. Gaming routers offer higher speeds compared to standard models. Budget: Align your budget with your preferred router model to ensure satisfaction with your purchase. Difference Between Router and Modem A router creates a LAN network, allowing multiple devices to connect to the internet, while a modem connects your home or office to the internet via a WAN network using a public IP address. Gaming Desktop Computer Components in Bangladesh | Computer components refer to the various hardware parts that come together to assemble a PC build. These components work together to allow the whole system to function effectively. Each PC component plays a vital role in shaping the performance, functionality, and user experience of a computer system. The processor (CPU), motherboard, RAM, storage devices like HDD or SSD, graphics card (GPU), power supply (PSU), casing, cooling solution, and monitor are the primary components that build a desktop PC. Whether you are building or upgrading a desktop computer, choosing the right combination of PC parts can deliver the optimal level of performance that you require. Best Computer Hub Ltd understands this and offers a large collection of PC components from leading brands at the most attractive prices in Bangladesh.

Types of PC Components

Desktop computers are built with various components that work together. Each component plays its role in the entire PC build. Below are the different types of computer components: Processor The computer processor, or CPU, is often referred to as the "brain" of a computer. It serves as the most important PC component when building a desktop computer. Intel and AMD are the two main manufacturers of computer processors. Intel's Core i3, i5, i7, and i9 series processors are widely used in desktop and laptop computers, offering a range of performance levels for different computing needs. The performance also varies based on the generation of Intel CPUs, such as the 10th, 11th, 12th, 13th, and 14th gen Intel processors. AMD Ryzen series CPUs are also popular for providing excellent value and performance, particularly for mid-range and high-end gaming PC setups. Motherboard The motherboard is the backbone of a PC build that ties all components together. This PC component provides slots and connectors for the CPU, RAM, storage devices, and expansion cards. Motherboards are available in various form factors such as ATX, Micro-ATX, Mini-ITX, and E-ATX, varying in size and capabilities. Popular brands like Asus, Gigabyte, MSI, ASRock, and EVGA offer a wide range of Intel Motherboards and AMD Motherboards. Motherboards from the Asus ROG series, Gigabyte AORUS series, MSI MEG series, and ASRock's Taichi series provide high-end options for building powerful desktop PCs for gaming and productivity. Graphics Card The graphics card is a specialized PC component designed to handle graphics rendering and video processing tasks, essential for gaming, video editing, and other graphics-intensive applications. NVIDIA's GeForce RTX and GTX series GPUs are widely used by gamers and content creators. The RTX 40 series, including the RTX 4090, RTX 4080, and RTX 4070, are the latest and most powerful GPUs for gaming and content creation. Also AMD's Radeon RX series provides excellent value and performance for gaming and general-purpose computing. Intel has recently entered the market with their Arc series graphics cards, including the Arc A770 and Arc A750 models. RAM RAM is another important component when building a new PC or upgrading an existing one. More RAM generally means better multitasking and overall system performance. Desktop RAM modules come in different capacities, speeds, and generations, with the latest being DDR5 RAM. While DDR4 RAM operates at bus speeds ranging from 2400 MHz to 4600 MHz, DDR5 RAM offers initial bus speeds starting at 4800 MHz and up to 8000 MHz. Popular choices for high-performance RAM kits designed for gaming and overclocking include Team’s Elite and Delta series, Corsair's Vengeance and Dominator series, G.Skill's Trident Z and Ripjaws series, Kingston's Fury lineup, and Crucial's Ballistix series. Storage Storage devices are the components that store data, programs, and the operating system. When building a PC, you can choose from two main types of storage devices: hard disk drives (HDDs) and solid-state drives (SSDs). HDDs offer large capacities at affordable prices, while SSDs provide faster data access speeds and improved overall system performance. Popular brands for HDDs include Western Digital, Seagate, Toshiba, and Hitachi, while leading brands for SSDs include Samsung (EVO and PRO series), Team (Group T-Force series), Crucial (MX and P series), Kingston (A400 and KC series), SanDisk (Extreme and Ultra series), Adata (XPG series), Western Digital (Blue and Black series), and Intel (660p and 670p series). Power Supply The most critical PC component in a computer system is the power supply, which delivers power to the other components in a PC build. A high-quality and properly sized PSU is essential for ensuring stable and reliable system operation, as well as providing adequate power for components to function optimally. This PC component comes with efficiency ratings like 80 PLUS (Bronze, Gold, Titanium). Higher ratings mean less power waste and lower electricity bills. So, Power Supply Units can be fully modular, semi-modular, and non-modular to offer different levels of cable management. Popular brands like Antec, Gamdias, Lian Li, Corsair, EVGA, Thermaltake, Cooler Master, DeepCool, and FSP offer a wide range of PSUs for different system configurations and power requirements. Casing The computer case, also known as the casing or chassis, is the enclosure of your build that houses all the internal components. It not only provides physical protection for the PC components but also plays a crucial role in airflow management and thermal performance. Some casings may offer features like tempered glass panels for showcasing internal components, RGB lighting for customizable aesthetics, and built-in fan controllers or smart device integration. Popular PC case brands include Antec, Gamdias, Lian Li, MaxGreen, NZXT, Corsair, Fractal Design, Thermaltake, and Cooler Master. Above all, these brands offer a wide range of desktop casings for different form factors, design preferences, and cooling requirements. Cooling Solution Cooling systems are the PC components that keep your system running cool and efficient. Effective cooling is crucial for maintaining optimal performance. Among the two main types of coolers, casing coolers are designed to manage airflow inside the computer casing to keep PC components at suitable temperatures. Popular casing cooler brands include Antec, Gamdias, Noctua, Corsair, and Arctic, which offer various case fan sizes, including 120mm, 140mm, and 200mm. Therefore, the CPU cooler is another essential PC part for dissipating the heat generated by the processor. Corsair, Antec, Gamdias, Team, Lian Li, Cooler Master, DeepCool, and NZXT offer a wide range of air coolers and liquid coolers compatible with Intel and AMD sockets. Monitor The monitor is a vital component for any gaming desktop setup, delivering the visual output that enhances your gaming experience. Monitors come in various sizes, resolutions, and refresh rates, impacting both gaming and productivity. Popular monitor brands include ASUS, Acer, Dell, LG, Samsung, BenQ, MSI, ViewSonic, Philips, AOC, and Razer. Moreover, these brands offer a range of options, from budget-friendly models to high-end gaming displays featuring fast refresh rates (144Hz, 240Hz), low response times (1ms), and technologies like G-Sync or FreeSync for smoother gameplay.

Frequency

Look for speakers that cover a wide range of human hearing (20 to 20,000 Hz) for the best audio experience. Brands like Bose and JBL provide speakers with excellent frequency response, ensuring clarity in sound reproduction.

Sound Pressure Level (SPL)

Consider the SPL, which measures the intensity of sound waves. For home use, moderate SPL speakers are sufficient, while higher SPL is ideal for large spaces or professional use. Brands like Sony, Yamaha, and Klipsch are known for their powerful SPL capabilities.

Connectivity

Choose speakers with diverse connectivity options, including wired (USB, RCA) and wireless (Bluetooth, Wi-Fi). Brands such as Samsung, Xiaomi, and Anker offer versatile connectivity options for seamless audio streaming.

Design & Aesthetics

Choose speakers that match your home decor. Brands like Bose, Yamaha, and Bang & Olufsen offer stylish designs, from traditional to modern aesthetics.

Water Resistance

For outdoor use, look for speakers with water resistance. Brands like JBL, Sony, and Ultimate Ears offer portable speakers with IPX ratings, ensuring durability in various weather conditions.

Rechargeable Batteries

Rechargeable batteries are crucial for portable speakers used outdoors or during gatherings. Brands like Anker, JBL, and Ultimate Ears offer speakers with long-lasting battery life, ensuring continuous playback.

description:

For PC gaming enthusiasts, a high-speed internet connection is vital. If you aspire to build a career as a professional gamer, choosing the right router is crucial for optimal internet connectivity. Notably, brands like Netgear, Asus, TP-Link, and D-Link are among the most popular options in the Bangladeshi market.

Popular Gaming Router Brands and Specifications

Here are some trending gaming routers available in Bangladesh along with their key specifications: 1. Netgear Nighthawk XR500 Speed: Up to 2.6 Gbps Wi-Fi Standard: 802.11ac (Dual-Band) Ports: 4 Gigabit Ethernet ports, 1 USB 3.0 port Features: QoS, DumaOS for traffic management, advanced security options 2. Asus ROG Rapture GT-AX11000 Speed: Up to 11 Gbps Wi-Fi Standard: 802.11ax (Tri-Band) Ports: 1 2.5G Ethernet port, 4 Gigabit Ethernet ports, 1 USB 3.0 port Features: Adaptive QoS, game acceleration, AiProtection for security 3. TP-Link Archer GX90 Speed: Up to 1800 Mbps Wi-Fi Standard: 802.11ax (Dual-Band) Ports: 1 WAN port, 3 LAN ports Features: Mesh technology for extended coverage, advanced security features 4. D-Link DIR-X6060 Speed: Up to 6000 Mbps Wi-Fi Standard: 802.11ax (Tri-Band) Ports: 4 Gigabit Ethernet ports, 1 USB 3.0 port Features: Smart Connect, D-Link Wi-Fi app for management 5. Linksys WRT32X Speed: Up to 3.2 Gbps Wi-Fi Standard: 802.11ac (Dual-Band) Ports: 4 Gigabit Ethernet ports, 1 USB 3.0 port Features: Killer Prioritization Engine, open-source firmware support

Benefits of Using a Gaming Router

Investing in a gaming router can significantly enhance your gaming experience through various advantages: Reduced Latency: Gaming routers prioritize gaming traffic, minimizing latency (ping) for a faster, more responsive connection, resulting in smoother gameplay. Enhanced Network Stability: Designed to maintain a stable connection, gaming routers use advanced QoS algorithms to prevent network congestion, ensuring consistent performance during gaming sessions. Optimized Bandwidth Allocation: With Quality of Service (QoS) features, you can allocate bandwidth specifically for gaming, ensuring your gaming data is prioritized over other types of traffic. Improved Wi-Fi Performance: Many gaming routers feature dual-band or tri-band technology, providing dedicated channels for gaming and reducing interference from other devices. Advanced Traffic Management: Gaming routers allow you to prioritize specific devices or applications, ensuring that your gaming setup receives the necessary resources for optimal performance. Better Connection for Multiplayer Gaming: They are equipped with features that minimize latency and packet loss, crucial for seamless communication and teamwork in multiplayer games. Enhanced Security Features: Built-in security features, such as firewalls and VPN support, help protect your gaming setup from potential threats. Improved Range and Coverage: With high-gain antennas or multiple external antennas, gaming routers enhance Wi-Fi range and coverage, ensuring a stable connection even in larger spaces.

Buying Guidelines for Gaming Routers in Bangladesh

When selecting a gaming router, consider the following guidelines to ensure you make the right choice: 1. Network Speed: Opt for routers that support high-speed connections, such as Gigabit Ethernet ports or Wi-Fi standards like 802.11ac or 802.11ax. 2. Quality of Service (QoS): Look for advanced QoS features that allow you to prioritize gaming traffic over other network activities. 3. Low Latency: Choose routers designed for low latency to minimize delay and enhance responsiveness during gaming. 4. Wired and Wireless Connectivity: Ensure the router has multiple Gigabit Ethernet ports and supports dual-band or tri-band Wi-Fi for optimal performance. 5. Range and Coverage: Select a router with powerful antennas or beamforming technology for extended Wi-Fi coverage. 6. Security Features: Look for robust security features, including built-in firewalls, VPN support, and guest network controls. 7. User-Friendly Interface: A router with an intuitive web interface or a dedicated mobile app makes it easier to customize settings and monitor performance. 8. Price and Budget: Set a budget and compare prices to find the best value. Best Computer Hub is a recommended place to explore competitive pricing.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is a gaming router, and why do I need one?

A gaming router optimizes network performance for online gaming, reducing latency and prioritizing gaming traffic for a seamless experience.

How is a gaming router different from a regular router?

Gaming routers are tailored for gaming, featuring advanced QoS, low latency optimizations, and dedicated LAN ports that ensure smoother gameplay compared to standard routers.

Can I use a regular router for gaming?

Yes, while a regular router can support gaming, gaming routers are optimized for gaming performance. Serious gamers may benefit significantly from investing in a gaming router. Are gaming routers compatible with all gaming consoles and devices? Generally, gaming routers are compatible with all consoles, PCs, and devices that connect to a network. However, it's advisable to check the compatibility with specific devices.

How to Choose the Best Multiplug and Power Strip

Finding the best multiplug can be overwhelming with so many options available. Here are key factors to consider:
  • Number of Outlets: Determine how many devices you need to connect. Multiplugs in Bangladesh typically offer 3 to 12 outlets. Choose one that accommodates all your devices.
  • USB Ports: Multiplugs with built-in USB ports are ideal for charging USB-powered devices like phones and tablets, eliminating the need for separate chargers.
  • Surge Protection: This feature protects your electronic devices from power spikes and surges, essential for safeguarding sensitive equipment like computers and TVs.
  • Power Rating: Check the power rating or wattage to ensure it can handle the combined power requirements of your devices, avoiding overheating and potential hazards.
  • Copper Wiring: Opt for multi plug with copper wiring for exceptional conductivity, durability, and longevity.
  • Power Cord Length: Choose a power strip with a sufficiently long cord to ensure flexibility in positioning without additional extension cords.
  • On/Off Switch: A power strip with an on/off switch allows control of the power supply, saving energy and providing a quick way to disconnect devices.
  • Indicator Light: An indicator light shows when the power is on, ensuring the multiplug functions correctly.
  • Safety Features: Look for features like surge protection, overload protection, overcurrent protection, and childproof outlets.
  • Brand Reputation: Choose reputable brands like Deli, Havit, Huntkey, Maxline, Anker, Targus, Belkin, and ORICO for QC-checked products. Best Computer Hub offers a wide range at competitive prices in Bangladesh.

Safety Measures for Using Multiplugs and Power Strips

  • Avoid Overloading: Do not exceed the maximum load capacity to prevent overheating, fire hazards, or damage to devices.
  • Unplug Unused Devices: Turn off or unplug the power strip when not in use to save electricity and reduce risks.
  • Avoid Daisy-chaining: Do not connect multiple power strips together to avoid circuit overload and fire hazards.
  • Keep Away from Water: Avoid using power strips in areas where they may come into contact with water, such as kitchens or bathrooms.

Wired Headphones

Wired headphones connect to devices via a 3.5mm or USB cable, offering reliable and uninterrupted audio quality. They are ideal for music enthusiasts and professionals who prioritize high-quality sound with minimal latency.

Wireless Headphones

Wireless headphones offer freedom of movement, connecting to devices via 2.4 GHz radio frequency or Bluetooth. They are perfect for an active lifestyle, gym workouts, and outdoor activities.

Bluetooth Headphones

Bluetooth headphones provide a seamless wireless listening experience, pairing easily with Bluetooth-enabled devices. They are great for on-the-go listening and hands-free calling.

Budget

Sound Quality

Form Factor

Choose between over-ear (circumaural) and on-ear (supra-aural) headphones based on your comfort preference. Over-ear headphones offer extended listening comfort, while on-ear headphones are more compact.

Connectivity

Decide between wired and wireless headphones based on your mobility needs and audio quality preference.

Design

Headphones come in closed-back, open-back, and semi-open-back designs. Closed-back headphones offer excellent sound isolation, while open-back headphones let you hear ambient sounds. Semi-open-back headphones provide a balance between the two.

Noise-Canceling

Microphone

name: Active Network Devices
description:
Buying Types of  Networking Component in Bangladesh

Wi-Fi Broadband Router (TP-Link, ASUS, Netgear, Linksys, D-Link, Xiaomi, Huawei)

A Wi-Fi Broadband Router from brands like TP-Link, ASUS, Netgear, Linksys, D-Link, Xiaomi, and Huawei provides reliable wireless connectivity for homes and offices. These routers offer various features such as dual-band support, high-speed data transmission, and wide coverage to handle multiple devices efficiently.

Ethernet Router (Cisco, Linksys, MikroTik, Ubiquiti, D-Link, DrayTek, TP-Link)

Ethernet Routers from Cisco, Linksys, MikroTik, Ubiquiti, D-Link, DrayTek, and TP-Link are known for their robust performance in professional environments. These routers ensure reliable wired connections, perfect for businesses or setups that demand stability and fast speeds.

Wi-Fi Access Point / Range Extender (Ubiquiti, TP-Link, D-Link, ASUS, Netgear, Cisco, Zyxel)

Brands like Ubiquiti, TP-Link, D-Link, ASUS, Netgear, Cisco, and Zyxel offer Wi-Fi Access Points and Range Extenders that are perfect for expanding network coverage. Ubiquiti’s UniFi series is well-known for larger spaces, while TP-Link and Netgear provide reliable options for home environments.

Switch (Cisco, Netgear, TP-Link, D-Link, Juniper Networks, HPE Aruba, Zyxel)

Network Switches from brands like Cisco, Netgear, TP-Link, D-Link, Juniper Networks, HPE Aruba, and Zyxel offer robust and scalable networking solutions. Cisco is a leader in enterprise-grade solutions, while Netgear and TP-Link cater to small and medium-sized businesses.

Wi-Fi Receiver / Adapter (TP-Link, ASUS, Netgear, D-Link, Alfa Network, Edimax)

Wi-Fi Receivers/Adapters from TP-Link, ASUS, Netgear, D-Link, Alfa Network, and Edimax enable older desktops or laptops to connect to wireless networks. These devices are often plug-and-play, providing a quick and easy solution for upgrading devices to support Wi-Fi.

MikroTik Products (MikroTik)

MikroTik offers a range of professional networking equipment such as RouterBOARD and Cloud Core Routers, making it a popular choice for ISPs, businesses, and enterprises. Their products provide advanced features like routing, switching, and wireless connectivity, all at an affordable price.

FTTx (Huawei, ZTE, Nokia, FiberHome, Cisco, Adtran)

FTTx solutions from Huawei, ZTE, Nokia, FiberHome, Cisco, and Adtran deliver high-speed fiber optic internet to homes, businesses, and data centers. These brands are instrumental in building next-generation fiber infrastructures worldwide, providing blazing-fast connectivity.

Media Converter (TP-Link, D-Link, TRENDnet, Allied Telesis, Perle Systems)

Media Converters from brands like TP-Link, D-Link, TRENDnet, Allied Telesis, and Perle Systems enable seamless integration between different types of network media. These converters are essential when integrating fiber networks with copper-based Ethernet systems.

Firewall (Fortinet, Cisco, Sophos, Palo Alto Networks, Check Point, SonicWall)

Firewalls from Fortinet, Cisco, Sophos, Palo Alto Networks, Check Point, and SonicWall provide comprehensive protection for businesses and home networks. These solutions are designed to guard against cyber threats, malware, and unauthorized access.

Network Ethernet Card / LAN Card (Intel, TP-Link, Realtek, ASUS, Broadcom)

Networking Component like Network Ethernet Cards from Intel, TP-Link, Realtek, ASUS, and Broadcom ensure reliable and fast wired connectivity for computers and servers. Intel and Broadcom are trusted for enterprise-grade performance, while TP-Link and Realtek cater to home and small office needs.

PoE Injector (Ubiquiti, TP-Link, TRENDnet, Cisco, D-Link, MikroTik)

Networking Component like PoE (Power over Ethernet) Injectors from Ubiquiti, TP-Link, TRENDnet, Cisco, D-Link, and MikroTik allow both power and data to be sent over a single Ethernet cable. This is especially useful for powering devices like wireless access points, IP cameras, and VoIP phones in areas without access to electrical outlets.

name: Passive Network Devices
description:
Networking Cable

Passive Networking Devices | Networking cables are essential for transferring data across a network, with options like Cat5e, Cat6, and Cat7 offering various speeds and shielding. Belden and Panduit produce high-quality cables known for durability and minimal signal interference, while CommScope and Nexans are renowned for their reliable long-distance transmission capabilities. Siemon, Leviton, and D-Link are also trusted for delivering exceptional performance in structured cabling systems.

Face Plate

Face plates provide a clean finish to network connections on walls or desks. Schneider Electric and Legrand offer sleek designs that blend well in both commercial and residential setups. Panduit and Hubbell provide customizable plates that accommodate multiple jacks, while Siemon, Honeywell, and Molex are known for durable, easy-to-install face plates that integrate seamlessly with their other cabling products.

Modular Jack

Passive Networking Devices Like Modular jacks, such as the RJ45, are key connectors for Ethernet cables, ensuring secure and stable connections. Siemon and Leviton are leading manufacturers providing high-quality jacks with excellent electrical performance. Panduit, Schneider Electric, and AMP NetConnect offer a wide range of modular jacks designed for fast installations and long-term reliability in commercial networks. CommScope and Molex are also trusted names for modular connectivity solutions.

Patch Cord

Patch cords are short cables that connect devices to network outlets or patch panels. Belkin and Tripp Lite produce durable patch cords for both home and enterprise use, with color-coded options for easy identification. Black Box and Siemon offer patch cords with enhanced shielding for environments where minimizing interference is crucial, while Leviton, Panduit, and CommScope provide reliable patch cords for data centers and structured cabling systems.

Patch Panel

Patch panels are used in networking to organize and route cables from various devices. Panduit and Siemon offer highly modular patch panels that simplify network management and reduce troubleshooting time. CommScope and Legrand provide heavy-duty panels ideal for large data centers, while Leviton and Black Box are known for their compact designs suited for smaller installations. Molex offers customizable options for more flexible networking setups.

RJ45 Connector

Passive Networking Devices like RJ45 connectors are critical for terminating Ethernet cables. AMP NetConnect and Platinum Tools are known for producing connectors that provide a reliable and tight connection, reducing signal loss. Leviton, Siemon, and Panduit produce connectors that support high-speed data transfers, making them ideal for modern networks. TRENDnet and Molex offer durable, easy-to-install RJ45 connectors used across various applications.

Wire Manager

Wire managers help organize and protect network cables, maintaining a neat and safe environment. Panduit and Legrand offer highly effective wire management solutions for large data centers, ensuring that cables are well-organized and easy to access. Middle Atlantic and Siemon provide robust products designed for ease of use in dense cable setups, while Best Computer Hub Ltd and Black Box focus on wire management solutions for smaller offices. Chatsworth offers innovative designs that maximize space efficiency.

SFP Module

SFP (Small Form-factor Pluggable) modules allow networking devices to connect via fiber optics, ensuring high-speed data transmission over long distances. Cisco and Finisar are industry leaders in the SFP market, known for their reliable, high-performance transceivers. Juniper and TP-Link offer cost-effective options, while Ubiquiti and Dell focus on compatibility with a wide range of devices. HP also provides durable SFP modules that are ideal for enterprise networks.

Network Rack

Network racks house networking equipment like servers, switches, and patch panels, keeping everything organized and protected. name: SAN Storage
description:
Storage Area Network (SAN) Price in Bangladesh

Storage Area Network (SAN) Price in Bangladesh | A Storage Area Network (SAN) is a specialized network storage solution designed for businesses and enterprises to run critical applications with low latency and high throughput. SAN storage units utilize all-flash storage components, offering consistent low latency and superior performance compared to traditional HDDs. SAN systems use various tools and methodologies, including centralized shared storage, data protection, disaster recovery, and security, for enhanced data management. SAN storage units utilize modular LUNs (Logical Unit Numbers) for efficient data storage, making them a dominant choice in the enterprise network storage market.

Popular SAN Storage Brands & Series in 2024

In 2024, several SAN storage brands and series stand out for their reliability and performance. Notable options include:
  • Dell EMC: PowerMax & PowerStore series
  • Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE): Primera & Nimble series
  • Hitachi Vantara: VSP series
  • IBM: FlashSystem series
  • Infinidat: InfiniBox series
  • NetApp: All Flash series
  • Pure Storage: FlashArray series

Difference Between SAN and NAS Storage

While both SAN and NAS are network storage solutions, they serve different purposes:
  • SAN (Storage Area Network): A localized block-type storage unit designed for high performance and low latency. SAN supports both Ethernet and fiber channels and is ideal for performance-sensitive applications like databases and virtual desktops.
  • NAS (Network Attached Storage): A centralized network of server storage primarily for data sharing. NAS relies on Ethernet and focuses on manageability, scalability, ease of use, and lower Total Cost of Ownership (TCO). NAS servers use protocols like FTP, SMB, and CFS and are similar to Windows or Linux servers in functionality but dedicated solely to data storage.

Easy-to-Install Server Storage with Low Maintenance

One of the key advantages of SAN storage is its ease of installation and low maintenance requirements. SAN storage is ideal for running business-critical and performance-sensitive applications such as Oracle databases, Microsoft SQL Server databases, large virtual desktop infrastructures (VDIs), SAP, and large ERP or CRM environments. SAN storage uses various protocols for connectivity, including:
  • Fiber Channel Protocol (FCP): Works with SCSI commands for reliable performance.
  • Internet Small Computer System Interface (iSCSI): Encapsulates SCSI with an FC frame and Ethernet Datagram.
  • Fiber Channel over Ethernet (FCoE): Used in a small percentage of SAN systems.
  • FC-NVMe: Utilizes PCI-Bus NVMe parallel storage queues for enhanced speed and efficiency.

Types of Air Conditioner (AC) based on Compressor

There are two kinds of ACs available in the market. ·         Inverter Air Conditioner ·         Non-Inverter Air Conditioner Basically, the term Inverter and Non-Inverter refers to the compressor types of Air Conditioner. Both kinds of ACs have their own advantages and disadvantages. Users can choose to buy one of these as per their requirements and budget. Inverter AC Inverter Air Conditioners are capable of adjusting temperature by changing motor speed without fully shutting down the motor. As a result, it ensures energy efficiency by consuming less energy since the motor does not frequently turn ON and OFF. Non-Inverter AC In Non-Inverter Air Conditioners, the temperature is not ideally adjusted since the AC remains constant and needs to turn ON and OFF in a timely manner, which makes it less energy efficient. There is also another updated Air Conditioner type, which is Dual-Inverter AC. Dual Inverter (Twin Rotary Compressors) AC Dual-inverter Air Conditioners function by two compressors in a single process. A Dual-Inverter Air Conditioner can provide individuals with desired cooling at the lowest possible speed and noise compared to an inverter AC. It vastly helps cut down your monthly electricity bills throughout the year. Which is better, Inverter or Non-Inverter AC? Inverter air conditioners are for low-budget users who do not mind frequent temperature fluctuations during AC operation. A Portable AC transfers excessive humidity from the air in the room to outside via a hose pipe and makes the room air cool through a motor.

And the last one, which is a Portable Air Conditioner, is perfect for small places. Another unique feature of this type of AC is that users can seamlessly drag it from one room to another.

Condenser Type The AC condenser plays a vital role in refrigeration and air conditioning. It promptly circulates the hot air coming from the compressor across the coil for effective heat transfer. Energy Star Rating ENERGY STAR-owned models strictly comply with the energy efficiency guidelines set by any particular country. 5 Star Rating ACs are available in most of the brands today. Eco-Friendly Mode Running the Air Conditioner in ECO mode enables it to use less compressor capacity. Therefore, ECO ACs use less energy and cut off the bill at the end of the month. So, It decreases energy loss by minimizing friction and allowing the smooth flow of the refrigerant throughout the pipes. Removable AC Filters Therefore, Air Conditioners have dust filters, which must be cleaned regularly for optimum airflow. Removable AC filters allow users to easily uninstall them themselves and clean them without the help of a technician. Self-Cleaning Feature Moreover, AC's self-cleaning feature is one of the most advanced features of an Air Conditioner. With this feature, AC automatically performs some actions to eliminate all dirt inside the machine. Motherboard at the Best Price in BD | A motherboard is the heart of any PC, serving as a printed circuit board (PCB) that connects essential components like the processor (CPU), graphics processing unit (GPU), memory module (RAM), and storage. It ensures seamless communication between these components and houses subsystems such as I/O points, memory controllers, and interface connectors. In earlier times, motherboards were constructed using card-cage PCBs with interconnected sockets, but after the microprocessor revolution, they evolved significantly. Today’s motherboards integrate serial and parallel ports, along with audio, video, storage, and networking functions. Modern devices like smartphones, laptops, and desktops rely on these compact, efficient motherboards to function smoothly.

Popular Motherboard Brands

Choosing the right motherboard is crucial whether you're building a gaming rig or a high-performance work PC. Renowned brands like Asrock, ASUS, Gigabyte, MSI, and NZXT offer a variety of motherboards suited for different needs, from basic workstations to advanced gaming setups. Selecting a motherboard from a reputable brand ensures your system runs efficiently, improving overall performance.

Motherboard for Intel Processor

If you're using an Intel processor, several motherboard options are available based on the generation and chipset of your CPU. For instance, Intel’s 4th and 5th generation processors are compatible with LGA 1155 and LGA 1150 sockets, while the 6th through 9th generations use LGA 1151. The latest 12th, 13th, and 14th generation Intel processors require LGA 1700 CPU sockets and support cutting-edge features like DDR5 RAM, high-speed USB 3.0 ports, and advanced video encoding technologies like HEVC and HDR.

Motherboard for AMD Processor

AMD processors typically use PGA socket types. The AM4 socket is the most versatile, compatible with various AMD CPUs, from entry-level Athlon APUs to the latest Ryzen processors. For high-performance setups, the TRX4 and sWRX8 sockets are used by the Ryzen Threadripper series, designed for gaming PCs and professional workstations with multicore CPUs, larger caches, and more PCIe lanes.

Factors to Consider Before Choosing a Motherboard

Regardless of whether you're building an Intel or AMD system, consider several key factors when choosing a motherboard. These include the form factor (ATX, Micro-ATX, Mini-ATX, or ITX), the number of PCIe slots, the type of RAM slots (DIMM), and storage options such as SATA 3.0 and NVMe M.2. The storage ports, especially for SSDs, offer significantly faster read and write speeds compared to HDDs, enhancing overall system performance.

CPU coolers come in two main types: active and passive. Active coolers use fans, pumps, or coolant to dissipate heat, while passive coolers rely solely on metal components to conduct heat away from the CPU. Most modern CPU coolers are active, with air and liquid cooling systems being the most common.

  • Liquid Coolers: These systems use synthetic coolant and a combination of pumps, water blocks, and radiators to efficiently cool the CPU. Liquid coolers offer better heat management than air coolers and are a popular choice for high-performance PCs.

Virtual Reality ( VR ) price in Bangladesh | VR, or Virtual Reality, is one of the most advanced forms of technology available today. The first VR system was created by scientist Morton Heilig, whose multimedia device, the Sensorama, is considered one of the earliest examples of virtual reality. The term “virtual reality” was later coined in 1987 by researcher Jaron Lanier. Today, VR is used across various industries, including marketing, entertainment, and gaming, becoming an essential accessory for gamers worldwide.

What Types of VR Are Currently Available?

Virtual Reality systems are categorized into four main types based on their design and technical specifications:
  1. Standalone VR: These wireless headsets do not require a connection to a PC or smartphone. Known as all-in-one VR, they offer mobility and practicality, but may sacrifice video quality and graphics. The Oculus Quest 2 is a popular example.
  2. PC VR: These systems require a gaming PC for connection, providing high graphical detail for a more immersive experience. Examples include the Valve Index and HTC Vive.
  3. Console VR: Designed for gaming consoles like PlayStation and Xbox, these headsets feature extensive gaming libraries and exclusive titles. Examples include PS4 and PS5 VR headsets.
  4. Smartphone VR: The easiest way to experience VR, though limited in capabilities and features compared to other systems. They are cost-effective but lack advanced audio and motion tracking.

Are Virtual Reality (VR) Systems Worth Buying?

If you're considering purchasing a VR system, here are key reasons to invest in one:
  • VR systems replicate real-life scenarios with high-quality computer-generated imagery (CGI) and refresh rates.
  • They provide a safe and controlled gaming environment.
  • Many systems offer interactive educational experiences for distance learning.
  • VR can simplify complex problems and real-life challenges.
  • These systems are innovative and applicable in various modern technology fields, including Augmented Reality and cloud computing.
  • They come with minimal risks of performance drops and enhance gameplay significantly.

What Technical Aspects Are Important Before Buying a VR System?

When choosing a VR system, consider these critical technical aspects:
  • Good resolution per eye
  • A wider field of view (FOV) for immersion
  • High refresh rate for smooth visuals
  • Inbuilt positional tracking capabilities
  • Audio connectivity options
  • Available space for installation

Tethered or Untethered VR: Which Should You Choose?

The connection type significantly impacts the VR experience. Tethered VR headsets require a cable connection to a PC or gaming console, providing powerful experiences thanks to high processing capabilities. Popular tethered models include the older Oculus Rift and HTC Vive. On the other hand, untethered VR headsets are wireless and work with smartphones, offering an immersive experience without the need for additional equipment. These headsets often come at a lower price point due to their simpler design.

name: Wi-Fi Router
description:
Best Wi-Fi Router Price in Bangladesh

Best Wi-Fi Router Price in Bangladesh starts from BDT 950 to BDT 230,000 depending on features and brands. A router is a crucial networking device that sends and receives data across various computer networks. Unlike modems or network hubs, routers combine the functionalities of these devices to connect multiple gadgets seamlessly. By directing internet traffic, a router allows multiple devices to share the same internet connection efficiently. In today’s connected world, routers are essential for homes, businesses, and institutions. Best Computer Hub Ltd, a leading tech retail brand in Bangladesh, offers a wide range of Wi-Fi, dual-band, and wired routers at competitive prices.

Popular Brands of Routers in Bangladesh

wifi router price in bd - Routers manage data packets, directing traffic from one router to another until it reaches its destination. At Best Computer Hub, you can find high-quality wired and wireless routers from top brands like Tenda, TP-Link, Totolink, Mikrotik, Wavlink, D-Link, HUAWEI, Mi, Cisco, Netgear, Mercusys, and Netis, all available at convenient prices.

Key Features to Consider When Buying a Router

Wi-Fi Frequency and Transmission: Most routers operate on the 2.4 GHz band, while some offer 5 GHz bands. Dual-band routers support both frequencies, ideal for varied uses. Typical routers transmit up to 300 Mbps on 2.4 GHz, while gaming routers can reach up to 1000 Mbps. The latest Wi-Fi 7 routers offer speeds up to 320 MHz or 6 GHz. Antenna Type: Routers feature either omnidirectional or directional antennas. Omnidirectional antennas provide broad coverage with a round radiation pattern, ideal for general indoor and outdoor use. Directional antennas focus the signal in one direction, offering limited but stronger coverage. Connectivity: Modern routers often support wireless connectivity (Wi-Fi 7), allowing devices to connect wirelessly within a broad range, making them suitable for homes and offices. Ethernet Ports: Ethernet ports connect devices directly to the internet. Many routers offer Gigabit Ethernet for high-speed wired connections. Typically, routers come with 1 WAN port and 2-4 LAN ports.

Varieties of Routers

Wireless Routers: Manage internet traffic wirelessly within offices, homes, or public areas. They convert wired broadband data into radio signals. Wired Routers: Connect devices in a local area network (LAN) through wired connections, often featuring built-in firewalls. Outdoor Routers: Extend Wi-Fi networks over long distances, ideal for large or remote areas. Gigabit Routers: Offer high-speed data transmission up to 1000 Mbps, suitable for extensive coverage areas. Pocket Routers: Portable router with SIM slots and power banks, perfect for on-the-go connectivity. Mesh Routers: Create a seamless network over large areas by linking multiple Wi-Fi networks. Tri-band and Dual-band Routers: Offer multiple frequency bands for improved bandwidth and speed.

Uses and Benefits of Routers

Regular Users: Basic wifi router with 300 Mbps speed are sufficient for personal use. Gamers: High-speed routers (above 1000 Mbps) with advanced features enhance the gaming experience. Offices: Business-class routers from brands like Cisco and Ubiquiti offer advanced features and support. Traveling: Portable routers provide remote Wi-Fi access and often come with SIM slots.

Choosing the Right Router in Bangladesh

Wi-Fi Coverage: Ensure the router covers the required area, from 100 feet indoors to 5000 sq. ft. with mesh routers. Speed: Choose based on your needs—standard speeds for regular use, higher speeds for gaming. Budget: Align your budget with the router's features to find the best option.

Pocket Router Price in BD

A pocket router is a compact and portable device that allows users to access the internet on the go. Ideal for travelers, students, or remote workers, it provides Wi-Fi connectivity using a SIM card or existing network. With easy setup and battery-powered operation, pocket routers are convenient for mobile internet needs. The pocket router price in BD varies depending on the brand and features, typically ranging from ৳1,500 to ৳3,500. Popular models from TP-Link, Huawei, and other brands offer reliable performance. Whether for personal or business use, a pocket router is a smart solution for wireless connectivity anytime, anywhere.

Difference Between Router and Modem

A router creates a LAN network, enabling internet access for multiple devices. Some routers connect internal networks to external networks (internet). A modem, however, connects directly to the internet using a WAN network via a public IP address. For the best selection and router price in bd, visit Best Computer Hub Ltd, the leading electronics retailer. Upgrade your home or office network with high-quality routers your needs.

Sharp and Ricoh photocopiers also offer reliable performance with diverse feature sets and price points. Best Computer Hub Ltd brings you the latest photocopy machines from these renowned brands at the best prices to streamline your workflow efficiently.

Types of Photocopiers

Photocopy machines come in various types, each offering distinct features to meet different needs: Black and White (Mono) Photocopier Mono photocopiers use black toner to produce monochrome copies, making them ideal for office environments where color isn't essential. They range in capacity from low to high volume, with some models capable of printing up to 150 pages per minute. Color Photocopy Machine Color photocopy machines can produce both colored and black-and-white copies, using cyan, magenta, yellow, and black toners (CMYK) to create a wide spectrum of colors. Desktop Photocopier These compact photocopy machines are designed to sit conveniently on a desktop, offering various capabilities. They can be basic or multifunctional, with options to expand paper capacity by adding additional trays. High-Volume Photocopier High-volume photocopiers are essential for organizations that require extensive copying. These machines are ideal for reprographics departments and print rooms, with a copy speed of up to 50 pages per minute. Network Photocopier Network photocopiers are perfect for shared office environments, connecting to a company's network and allowing multiple users to copy, print, and scan wirelessly. These machines also provide centralized control and monitoring to improve efficiency. Laser Photocopier Laser photocopiers are known for their high performance, extended life, speed, and print quality. While initially more expensive, laser photocopy machines offer cost-effective operation over time. Inkjet Photocopier Inkjet photocopiers are ideal for small offices or home use due to their affordability and efficiency. Compared to laser printers, inkjet photocopy machines may have slower copy speeds and lower print quality.

Photocopy Machine Buying Guide

When selecting a photocopy machine for your business in Bangladesh, consider the following factors to ensure it meets your specific needs: Speed and Efficiency Choose a machine with a speed that matches your workload. A small office might need a machine with a speed of 20-30 ppm, while a larger office may require a machine with 40 ppm or more for high-volume tasks. Copy Volume Determine your daily or monthly copying needs and select a machine with a duty cycle that comfortably matches your workload. Paper Handling and Size Evaluate the machine's paper handling capabilities, including capacity, types of paper it can accommodate, and features like duplex printing. Quality and Resolution Consider the print quality and resolution. For standard documents, 600 dpi is sufficient, but for graphics or images, a resolution of 1200 dpi or higher is preferable. Connectivity Options Look for machines with connectivity options like Wi-Fi, Ethernet, USB, and mobile printing to ensure compatibility with various devices and operating systems. Functionality Determine the features you need, such as scanning, faxing, stapling, hole punching, or booklet making, to enhance productivity. Energy Efficiency Look for energy-saving features like Energy Star certification, automatic sleep mode, and fast warm-up times to reduce energy consumption and operating costs. What is a Digital Video Recorder (DVR)?

A Digital Video Recorder (DVR) captures video footage and stores it on a local device, typically a hard drive. DVRs can record from analog sources or digital cameras connected via coaxial cables, enabling remote access. They offer advanced features like event recording search and time/date sorting, with automatic overwriting of old footage when storage is full.

Key Features of DVR Machines

  • Rack-Mountable: Easy to install in server racks.
  • Multiple Inputs: Support for coaxial and optical cables.
  • External Monitor Output: Connect to external monitors.
  • PTZ Camera Support: Control pan, tilt, and zoom functions.
  • Event Notifications: Alerts for security events.
  • Connection Problem Alerts: Notifies users of connection issues.

DVR vs. NVR

  • Footage Conversion: DVRs convert analog footage to digital, while NVRs work with digital footage.
  • Camera Types: DVRs use analog cameras; NVRs use digital cameras.
  • Setup Complexity: DVRs are simpler to set up and troubleshoot; NVRs support higher resolutions (8MP, 12MP).
  • Scalability: DVRs have fixed input channels, suitable for small setups; NVRs are cloud-based and scalable.
  • Storage: DVRs store footage locally; NVRs store footage in the cloud, offering higher quality.

Extend Your Network with the Best WiFI Access Point/Range Extender at the Best Price in Bangladesh

WiFI Access Point/Range Extender price in Bangladesh | An access point, also known as a wireless access point (WAP), range extender, or AP, connects directly to a wired local area network (usually Ethernet), allowing Wi-Fi devices to connect seamlessly to the network. In most cases, it connects to a router, either as a standalone device or as part of an access point router. Access points expand the network, enabling multiple wireless devices to stay connected efficiently.
Difference Between Access Points and Routers
While routers send data packets to their destination, access points primarily allow wireless devices to connect using antennas. Today's routers are multifunctional, offering features like routing, switching, DHCP, DNS, and built-in access points. However, standalone access points serve a single purpose—extending the network range. While a router can perform access point functions, an access point cannot act as a router.

What are FTTX Products?

FTTX stands for Fiber to the X, where the "X" represents different network configurations like FTTH (Fiber to the Home), FTTB (Fiber to the Building), and FTTC (Fiber to the Curb).   • Fiber Splitters: These devices are used to split optical signals from a single fiber to multiple users or locations.
  • Fiber Patch Cords: These cords are used for connecting devices to the fiber network and are crucial for establishing a stable connection.

Crimping Tool – The Must-Have Networking Tool for Reliable Cable Terminations

A Crimping Tool is an essential instrument for anyone involved in networking, telecommunications, or electrical work. Whether you're a professional technician, an IT installer, or a DIY enthusiast, a high-quality crimping tool allows you to securely attach connectors to cables—ensuring strong, reliable, and long-lasting connections. From RJ45 Ethernet cables to RJ11 telephone lines, this tool makes cable assembly fast, efficient, and precise. Looking to buy a crimping tool in Bangladesh? Trust Best Computer, your dependable source for authentic networking tools at the best prices.

🔧 What is a Crimping Tool?

A crimping tool is a hand-held device used to attach connectors, such as RJ45 or RJ11 plugs, to the ends of networking cables like CAT5, CAT6, and telephone wires. By compressing and "crimping" the metal contacts within the connector, the tool ensures a tight bond between the wires and the connector—enabling uninterrupted data transmission. Modern crimping tools often come with additional functions such as cable stripping, cutting, and testing, making them multifunctional and efficient for both beginners and professionals.

⚙️ Key Features of a Professional Crimping Tool

  • Supports RJ45, RJ11, and RJ12 connectors
  • Built-in wire stripper and cutter for convenience
  • Durable carbon steel or alloy construction for long life
  • Ergonomic non-slip handles for comfortable grip
  • Ratcheting mechanism for consistent pressure and cleaner crimps
  • Compatible with CAT5e, CAT6, CAT6a cables
Using a quality crimping tool ensures faster installations, improved network reliability, and reduced chances of connection failures due to loose wires or poor contact.

🧰 Ideal for Home, Office, and Data Center Applications

Whether you are setting up a home network, configuring a small office, or working on a data center infrastructure, a crimping tool is a critical addition to your toolkit. With this tool, you can:

name: Cable Tester
description:
Cable Tester – The Essential Tool for Network Troubleshooting and Maintenance

A Cable Tester is an indispensable tool for IT professionals, technicians, and DIY enthusiasts who work with network, telephone, or data cabling systems. Whether you’re installing a new network, troubleshooting connection issues, or verifying the integrity of cables, a reliable cable tester ensures your system is performing at its best. Designed for efficiency, accuracy, and ease of use, cable testers help detect wiring faults, continuity issues, and misconfigurations within seconds. If you’re looking for a high-quality cable tester in Bangladesh, Best Computer is your trusted destination for authentic and affordable networking tools.

🔍 What is a Cable Tester?

A Cable Tester is a diagnostic tool used to verify the electrical connections in a signal cable or other wired assembly. It checks for issues such as open circuits, short circuits, miswiring, crossed pairs, and split pairs in different types of cables including Ethernet (RJ45), telephone lines (RJ11), coaxial, USB, and more. Cable testers range from simple handheld devices to advanced models with LED indicators and LCD displays that offer real-time diagnostics. Most testers come with a main testing unit and a detachable remote for testing long-distance or in-wall installations.

⚙️ Key Features of a Cable Tester

  • Compatibility with RJ45, RJ11, and other cable types
  • LED or digital indicators to display cable status and errors
  • Detects continuity faults, miswiring, shorts, and split pairs
  • Portable, compact, and easy to use
  • Battery-powered operation for on-the-go testing
  • Remote testing capability for cables in separate rooms or locations
Whether you're working with CAT5, CAT6, CAT7, or telephone lines, a cable tester helps ensure that your cabling system is wired correctly and functioning properly.

🧰 Ideal for Technicians, Installers & Home Users

From professional network engineers to DIY installers, anyone dealing with cable systems can benefit from using a cable tester. It’s perfect for:
  • Testing newly installed Ethernet cables before deployment
  • Troubleshooting no internet or dropped connection issues
  • Identifying damaged or faulty cables in complex networks
  • Ensuring proper wiring for office, home, or data center setups
With a cable tester, you can avoid costly mistakes and time-consuming guesswork by instantly identifying the source of a connectivity problem.

What is a KVM Switch and Why You Need One?

A KVM (Keyboard, Video, Mouse) Switch is a hardware device that enables you to control multiple computers using a single set of input devices. This reduces clutter, saves space, and makes it easier to manage several systems simultaneously without needing multiple keyboards and monitors. KVM switches are essential for IT professionals, data centers, system administrators, and anyone who works with multiple computers or servers regularly. By using a KVM switch, you can switch between computers quickly and efficiently, improving workflow and reducing hardware costs.

Features and Types of KVM Switches

At Best Computer Hub Ltd, we stock various KVM switches tailored to different needs. Our collection includes desktop KVM switches, rack-mounted KVM switches, USB KVM switches, HDMI and VGA KVM switches, and IP KVM switches for remote access. Features commonly found in these devices include support for multiple ports ranging from 2 to 16 or more, high-resolution video output, plug-and-play installation, hotkey switching, and USB peripheral sharing. Advanced KVM switches offer remote management capabilities, audio support, and compatibility with multiple operating systems. This variety ensures that whether you need a simple desktop switch or an enterprise-grade KVM solution, we have you covered.
